profile.headline: Software Engineer III at Ford
profile.summary:
With over 8 years of experience in software engineering, my mission has always been to create robust backend systems that drive business efficiency and innovation. At Amazon, I took pride in aligning my work with the company’s cutting-edge culture, bringing both diverse perspectives and a deep understanding of technical intricacies to the team. My field of expertise lies in designing and implementing negotiation platforms that serve critical business functions.

My tenure as a Software Development Engineer II was marked by significant contributions to Amazon’s negotiation systems. I led the design of a manual negotiation system and developed an incentive approval workflow that became a linchpin for retail operations. Mentoring junior engineers, I spearheaded the creation of a new vendor-facing webpage, harnessing my skills in Java and React to deliver a seamless user experience. Our collaborative efforts resulted in enhanced negotiation processes and set new standards for vendor interactions.

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description: Backend engineer for Ford Pro Intelligence Data Platform

positions.title: Software Development Engineer II
positions.description:
*	Manual Negotiation System used by Retail business team 
-	Designed to update existing internal Negotiation website and Java-based backend services for new use case without upstream opportunity data aligning with a dev team which owns the react front-end
-	Designed and implemented negotiation incentive approval service/workflow as a middle tier between negotiation incentive service and internal general approval platform
-	Proposed stop-buying API interface/workflow to an external team in order to integrate the API from Negotiation Incentive service in bulk asynchronous way
*	Automatic Negotiation Vendor-facing Front-end 
-	Led junior engineers when building a new vendor facing web page to show negotiation and receive vendor response and process the result by calling a backend service
-	Designed and implemented domain model and data access code of reading negotiation and processing vendor negotiation using latest domain concepts and legacy negotiation backend for impending migration of backend service
*	Automatic Vendor Offer Monitoring System
-	Designed and implemented vendor offer termination/skip evaluation workflow or/and API
-	Designed and implemented data migration solution from deprecating workflow to new workflow system with uninterrupted availability and consistency using messages
*	Negotiation Prediction Machine-Learning service 
-	Launch ML online service with model trained by scientists
-	Ran an experiment to compare an old model and a new one
-	Re-design an ML service for an automated model update

positions.title: Software Development Engineer I
positions.description:
*	Construct mobile web e-book preview on top of existing features
*	Improved e-book preview latency by 50%, optimizing dependent service call behavior
*	Implement customer-facing query solution for ebook series 
*	Launch book preview service into new markets such as Japan, China, Spain and Italy
*	Migrate Oracle database system for ingesting book samples to SQS, improving cost and maintainability
